patch.summary:
Choose AppDynamics only if your buying job matches “Cisco APM / observability — Infrastructure from ~$6/vCPU/mo; Premium (infra+apps) from $33” rather than Fly.io's shape. Choose Fly.io only if your buying job matches “Cloud PaaS / microVM app platform — PAYG; shared-cpu-1x from ~$1.94/mo in lower-cost regio” rather than AppDynamics's shape. Workflow advantage: AppDynamics leans observability-monitoring; Fly.io leans cloud-paas. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: AppDynamics is Cisco APM / observability — Infrastructure from ~$6/vCPU/mo; Premium (infra+apps) from $33/vCPU/mo annual; Enterprise $50/vCPU; often Cisco ; Fly.io is Cloud PaaS / microVM app platform — PAYG; shared-cpu-1x from ~$1.94/mo in lower-cost regions. Support Standard $29/mo is support, not hostin.
- Company-size focus: AppDynamics (mid-market, enterprise) vs Fly.io (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: AppDynamics-leaning observability-monitoring vs Fly.io-leaning cloud-paas.
- Researched limits: AppDynamics — Does not outrank Datadog (8.6); Fly.io — Does not outrank Render (7.9) as the cloud-paas award.

Limitations — AppDynamics: Does not outrank Datadog (8.6); $6/vCPU Infrastructure is not the APM-relevant floor — Premium $33 is; Fly.io: Does not outrank Render (7.9) as the cloud-paas award; Support Standard $29/mo is support — not the hosting floor.

Poor-fit cases: AppDynamics is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Does not outrank Datadog (8.6) · Fly.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Does not outrank Render (7.9) as the cloud-paas award · Avoid AppDynamics if you actually need Fly.io's motion (Cloud PaaS / microVM app platform — PAYG; shared-cpu-1x from ~$1.94/mo in lower-)
